```{r phylo-archetype}
plotAnc(
        king_lists_archetypes, 
        trait, 
        main = colnames(king_lists)[trait],
        col = colour("muted")(8),
        use.edge.length = TRUE, 
        show.node.label = TRUE
)
```

**Legend**

```{r phylo-archetype-key, results='asis'}
key <- levels(king_lists[,trait])
cat(paste0(1:length(key), ". ", key, collapse = "\n"))
```
